product_availability_policy.instructions: 1. Identify requested filters from Prospect message: brand, type, size, sizes, color, gender, min_price, max_price. 2. Apply deterministic filtering in this order: stock, brand, type, color, gender, min_price, max_price, size or sizes. 3. Return only in-stock or low-stock products. 4. Rank filtered products with deterministic scoring from recommendation engine. 5. Provide concise list-first output with model, type, available size context, and price. 6. Ask one clarifying question only when required details are missing for requested action.
product_availability_policy.triggers: 1. Activate this policy when intent is search_product. 2. Activate this policy when intent is check_availability. 3. Activate this policy when intent is check_category_availability.
product_availability_policy.constraints: 1. Never claim availability for out-of-stock products. 2. Never invent products, sizes, colors, prices, or stock levels. 3. Never bypass explicit user constraints when constraints are valid. 4. Keep deterministic business gender-size rule enforced by recommendation layer.
product_availability_policy.output_contract: 1. Start with direct answer sentence. 2. Continue with compact bullet-style product list when matches exist. 3. Offer one bounded next-step prompt only when needed to proceed.
